seasonalNotes: Cold winters (−5°C Dec–Feb). Warm summers (25–35°C Jun–Aug). Rainy in spring/autumn. Shops closed Sundays. Christmas markets Nov–Dec.

personas.name: Berlin Freelancer Day
personas.tagline: Coworking, döner, and a Spree walk
personas.description: A freelancer in Kreuzberg: morning café work, coworking space, Markthalle lunch, DM pharmacy run, and evening along the Spree.

stops.title: Café work session — charge laptop
stops.description: Grab a seat with a plug at Five Elephant.

stops.title: Client call at 11 — find quiet spot
stops.description: Video call. Need stable WiFi and quiet room.

stops.title: Lunch at Markthalle Neun
stops.description: Thursday is Street Food Thursday. Get there early.

stops.title: DM run — shampoo + vitamins
stops.description: DM on Kottbusser Damm. Check Payback points.

stops.title: Evening walk along the Spree
stops.description: Molecule Man to Oberbaumbrücke. Bring a jacket.

personas.name: Munich Weekend
personas.tagline: Marienplatz, beer garden, and English Garden
personas.description: A Saturday in Munich: Viktualienmarkt breakfast, Marienplatz, Pinakothek gallery, English Garden surfing, and a beer garden.

stops.title: Weißwurst breakfast at Viktualienmarkt
stops.description: Traditional: Weißwurst, Brezel, sweet mustard. Before 12 PM.

stops.title: Glockenspiel at Marienplatz
stops.description: Show at 11 AM and 12 PM. Get there 10 min early.

stops.title: Alte Pinakothek — €1 on Sundays
stops.description: Dürer, Rubens, da Vinci. Incredible collection.

stops.title: Watch surfers at Eisbachwelle
stops.description: River surfers in the English Garden. Always a crowd.
